label: Sanctions, export controls, and foreign-investment estate
domain: sanctions designations, export restrictions, denied parties, licenses, foreign-investment review, ownership, and national-security controls
scope: OFAC and UK sanctions designations, U.S. consolidated screening lists, BIS export-control restrictions, licenses and enforcement, CFIUS public actions and annual reports, UK National Security and Investment Act decisions, foreign ownership, transaction parties, controlled technologies, and explicit no-match controls. The estate preserves list version and effective date.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: A name match, list entry, review, mitigation agreement, blocked transaction, license, and enforcement action are different states. Absence from public CFIUS material cannot establish absence of review.

next_acquisition.operation: resolve counterparties and controlled transactions against versioned sanctions, export-control, and foreign-investment instruments
next_acquisition.decisive_output: entity- and transaction-level control ledger with exact identifiers, list version, legal authority, effective dates, disposition, license or mitigation, and explicit public-coverage limits
